entities.name: Matúš Sukeľ
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matúš Sukeľ is a Slovak professional ice hockey player who is a forward for HC Litvínov of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He was selected and competed in the 2018 Winter Olympics for Slovakia. He is twin brother of Jakub Sukeľ.
